correct_ahj: City of Raleigh Planning and Development Department
job_type: Place a detached prefabricated residential storage shed measuring exactly 10 feet long by 10 feet wide by 10 feet high on a one-family property. The shed has no electricity, plumbing, mechanical equipment, conditioned space, or habitable use. The property has public water and sewer and is not in a historic district or designated as a Raleigh Historic Landmark.

supports: Raleigh requires a permit regardless of accessory-structure size.
An accessory structure under 12 feet in every direction receives a zoning permit.
A building permit applies if the structure exceeds 12 feet in any direction.
Storage sheds are expressly identified as accessory structures.
For structures under 12 feet in every direction, the completed application and supporting documents are submitted to DowntownDS@raleighnc.gov.
